def exponential(h: np.ndarray, coefficient: float) -> np.ndarray:
    values, vectors = np.linalg.eigh(h)
    return (vectors*np.exp(-coefficient*values))@vectors.conj().T


def primitive_kernel(core: Any, profile: dict[str, Any], theta: np.ndarray, f: np.ndarray, delta: float, quadrature: int) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    nodes, weights = np.polynomial.hermite.hermgauss(quadrature)
    h = core.basis.fine_module.matter_hamiltonian
    A0 = exponential(h(core.native, profile, theta), delta/2)
    midpoint, endpoint = np.zeros_like(A0), np.zeros_like(A0)
    for node, weight in zip(nodes, weights/np.sqrt(np.pi)):
        displacement = np.sqrt(4*core.fine.u*delta)*node*f
        midpoint += weight*exponential(h(core.native, profile, theta+displacement/2), delta)
        endpoint += weight*(A0@exponential(h(core.native, profile, theta+displacement), delta/2))
    return midpoint, endpoint
